summary: National Health Investors (NYSE:NHI) has finalized $89.2 million in new healthcare investments across four senior housing transactions, achieving an average initial yield of 8.20%. These investments include acquisitions and mortgage notes for facilities in Pennsylvania, Alabama, South Carolina, and Texas. The REIT has made $392.4 million in investments year-to-date in 2025 and is currently evaluating an additional pipeline of $423 million in senior housing opportunities.
